_comment: Intentionally OUTSIDE the root pnpm-workspace.yaml (packages/*). This is NOT an SDK package and is never resolved/built by the root pnpm/esbuild toolchain — it builds the WP-admin Gutenberg editor integration only, standalone via plain `npm install && npm run build` inside wordpress-plugin/. It shares nothing with packages/wp-bundle's esbuild build by design.
name: khaveeai-wordpress-plugin
